# CATERPI11AR

> Caterpi11ar AI is a software studio that builds intelligent tools and apps. We ship products that solve real problems — from smart travel maps to habit trackers to developer utilities. AI that evolves, built to last.

## Products

- [Locusify](https://locusify.cn): Privacy-first travel app that turns GPS photos into interactive route maps and animated journey replays. 100% on-device processing — no server uploads, no data collection.
- [Dentic](https://github.com/caterpi11ar/dentic): Habit-building app designed to help users develop a consistent, lifelong brushing routine using scientifically-backed habit formation techniques.
- [CC Notify](https://github.com/caterpi11ar/cc-notify): Cross-platform notification manager for AI CLI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI). Hooks, multi-channel routing, and a standalone CLI for headless workflows. Built with Tauri, React, and Rust.
- [LingoBar](https://github.com/caterpi11ar/lingobar): macOS menu bar clipboard translator built with SwiftUI and AppKit. Listens for clipboard changes and delivers instant translations with zero interruption. (剪贴板翻译)
- [WeChat Chat Generator](https://wechat.caterpi11ar.com/): Free online tool that creates realistic WeChat chat screenshots. Customize sender, messages, and timestamps instantly — no app required. (微信聊天截图生成器)

## Philosophy

- **Evolve Constantly** — Products never stop improving. Every release is a step forward, never the final form.
- **Ship What Matters** — Focus on real value over feature count. Solve problems that users actually have.
- **Build to Scale** — Architecture that grows with demand. From prototype to production without compromise.
- **Open by Default** — Transparent processes, open-source foundations. Community-driven evolution.

## About

Caterpi11ar AI was founded in 2025 by Qin Dai. We are a remote-first, global team focused on product and engineering. Several of our products are open source and available on GitHub.
